airlines.name: IndiGo

faq_extra.q: Is cabin bag weight checked on IndiGo?
faq_extra.a: IndiGo's cabin baggage page sets the limit (one bag up to 7 kg, plus a personal item up to 3 kg) but doesn't say when or how often it weighs cabin bags. Plan as if yours will be weighed: keep it within 7 kg, including the bag's own weight, and weigh it at home first. If the overhead bins are full, IndiGo may check your cabin bag in.

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: IndiGo allows one cabin bag per passenger, up to 7 kg. It must be no bigger than 55 x 35 x 25 cm, and the three sides together must not add up to more than 115 cm. IndiGo says this size includes wheels and handles.

personal.summary: One personal item up to 3 kg, like a ladies' purse or a small laptop bag

airlines.checkin_note: Each checked bag can be up to 158 cm in total (L + W + H). IndiGo doesn't allow a single checked bag over 32 kg.
notes: The Lite fare is only for direct flights booked on IndiGo's own website or app.
Infants get a 7 kg cabin bag but no check-in allowance.
IndiGo Stretch seats (its business-style cabin) get more: 30 kg (Stretch) or 40 kg (Stretch+) of check-in baggage in two pieces.

airlines.name: Air India

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Air India allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg in Economy and Premium Economy. It must be no bigger than 55 x 40 x 20 cm, and no more than 115 cm in total. On domestic flights you can pay for a heavier cabin bag, up to 12 kg.

personal.summary: One small bag up to 3 kg and 40 x 30 x 20 cm that fits under the seat

airlines.checkin_summary: 15 kg on Value, 20 kg on Classic, 25 kg on Flex
airlines.checkin_note: With less than 25 kg you get 1 piece; with 25 kg or more you can split it into 2 pieces. Each bag can be up to 158 cm in total and 32 kg. One Air India page shows Classic as 15 kg (25 kg on some routes), so check the allowance printed on your ticket.
notes: These rules are for flights operated by Air India itself, not Air India Express or codeshare flights.
Air India is testing a cheaper Basic fare on some domestic routes, with a 7 kg cabin bag and 15 kg of check-in baggage but no free meal.

airlines.name: Air India Express

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Air India Express allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg, no bigger than 56 x 36 x 23 cm (115 cm in total), including handles, wheels and side pockets. The Xtra Carry-On add-on lets you carry up to 12 kg.

personal.summary: A laptop bag up to 30 x 40 x 10 cm, but it shares the same 7 kg with your cabin bag

airlines.checkin_note: Air India Express's booking page shows 20 kg for Flex, but its FAQ says 15 kg for every fare except Lite, so check the allowance on your ticket. Each checked bag can be up to 81 x 119 x 119 cm and 32 kg.
notes: Air India Express's FAQ says the 7 kg includes your laptop and personal items. Plan for 7 kg in total across everything you carry on.
Infants get an extra 10 kg of check-in baggage but no cabin allowance.

airlines.name: Akasa Air

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Akasa Air allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 115 cm in total (L + W + H). Its Conditions of Carriage give the size as 55 x 35 x 25 cm.

personal.summary: One personal item up to 3 kg that fits under the seat in front of you

airlines.checkin_note: Each checked bag can be up to 158 cm in total and 32 kg.

airlines.name: SpiceJet

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: SpiceJet allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg, and a laptop bag or ladies' purse must fit inside that same 7 kg. On Boeing planes the bag must be within 55 x 35 x 25 cm (115 cm in total). On the smaller Q400 planes the limit is 50 x 35 x 23 cm (108 cm in total), so check the aircraft type on your booking. A passenger travelling with an infant can carry one more cabin bag of up to 7 kg, within the same size. SpiceJet's FAQ says a heavy cabin bag is charged at the boarding gate, at ₹750 per kg for up to 5 kg extra. Booked ahead, the Carry More On-board add-on adds 5 kg, so 12 kg in all, which is the most SpiceJet allows in the cabin.

personal.summary: A laptop bag or ladies' purse is allowed, but it counts inside the same 7 kg

checkin.allowance: 25 kg, 1 piece (15 kg + 10 kg), with a valid student ID shown at check-in

airlines.checkin_note: Each checked bag can be up to 158 cm in total (L + W + H), and no single bag may weigh more than 32 kg. If you carry less than 15 kg in your checked bag, the spare weight can't be moved to your cabin bag, and the other way round.

intl_checkin.fare: To and from Bangkok, Phuket and Kathmandu
intl_checkin.allowance: 20 kg in total, up to 2 pieces

intl_checkin.fare: To and from Dubai, Sharjah, Fujairah and Jeddah
intl_checkin.allowance: 30 kg in total, up to 2 pieces (plus 5 litres of Zamzam water from Jeddah to India)

intl_checkin.fare: International to international, changing SpiceJet flights in India
intl_checkin.allowance: 30 kg in total, up to 2 pieces

intl_checkin.fare: SpiceJet domestic flight that connects to another airline's international flight
intl_checkin.allowance: 15 kg, 1 piece (SpiceJet sells extra international connection kilos, booked at least 24 hours ahead)

notes: No through check-in: SpiceJet says it only flies point to point, so on a connection you collect your bag and check in again, even between two SpiceJet flights. Leave enough time between flights.
Check-in counters open 3 hours before departure and close 60 minutes before, for all flights. SpiceJet asks you to reach the airport at least 2 hours early.
Passengers on the same booking (PNR) can pool their checked baggage, as long as no single bag is over 32 kg.
Power banks may go only in your cabin bag. You can't use or charge them on board, and they can't go in the overhead bin. E-cigarettes are not allowed on any SpiceJet flight.
Keep medicines, cash, jewellery, documents and electronics in your cabin bag.
Liquor: up to 5 litres in retail packaging, between 24% and 70% alcohol, in checked baggage only.
Sikh passengers may wear a kirpan on domestic flights if the blade is no longer than 15.24 cm (6 inches) and the whole kirpan no longer than 22.86 cm (9 inches).
Hoverboards, self-balancing scooters and similar lithium-battery vehicles are not allowed.
On flights to Dubai, all checked bags are inspected, and pagers and walkie-talkies are confiscated.
These rules come from SpiceJet's corporate site (corporate.spicejet.com). The baggage address on spicejet.com loads only a booking app, with no rules we could read.

faq_extra.q: What is the SpiceJet baggage allowance for international flights?
faq_extra.a: It depends on the route. Flights to and from Bangkok, Phuket and Kathmandu get 20 kg in up to 2 pieces. Flights to and from Dubai, Sharjah, Fujairah and Jeddah get 30 kg in up to 2 pieces. The cabin bag is 7 kg on every route, and on international flights it can include a duty-free shopping bag.

faq_extra.q: What is the SpiceJet check-in baggage size?
faq_extra.a: Each checked bag can be up to 158 cm when you add its length, width and height. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, even if you buy extra kilos.

Plan as if it will. SpiceJet's FAQ says a cabin bag over 7 kg at the boarding gate is charged ₹750 per kg, for up to 5 kg extra, and 12 kg is the most allowed in the cabin. A laptop bag or purse counts inside the 7 kg.

faq_extra.q: What is the SpiceJet baggage allowance for students?
faq_extra.a: Students who book SpiceJet's student discount fare on a direct domestic flight get 25 kg of check-in baggage in one piece: the usual 15 kg plus 10 kg. Show a valid student ID at the check-in counter.

faq_extra.q: What is the SpiceJet baggage allowance for an infant?
faq_extra.a: A passenger travelling with an infant can carry one extra cabin bag of up to 7 kg, within the normal cabin size. SpiceJet's baggage pages don't list a separate check-in allowance for infants, so ask SpiceJet when you book.

faq_extra.q: Can I buy extra baggage after booking on SpiceJet?
faq_extra.a: Yes. Use Manage Booking on SpiceJet's website, the reservation centre or an airport ticket counter, up to 3 hours before a domestic flight or 6 hours before an international one. Each prepaid slab can be bought only once per passenger per flight. Extra cabin kilos (Carry More On-board) must be bought at least 12 hours ahead.

faq_extra.q: What should I do if SpiceJet loses or damages my bag?
faq_extra.a: Tell SpiceJet's airport staff before you leave the arrivals hall, so they can fill in a Baggage Irregularity Report, and keep a copy. We found no online baggage tracker on SpiceJet's baggage pages. Its 24/7 reservations lines are +91 124 4983410 and +91 124 7101600.

faq_extra.q: Can I carry a power bank on SpiceJet?
faq_extra.a: Only in your cabin bag, never in checked baggage. You can't use or charge it during the flight, and it can't go in the overhead bin, so keep it in the bag under the seat in front of you.
